label: sec:categorical-braiding-hecke-eigenbasis-preamble
html: Having established the categorical origin of braiding, we turn to the Hecke quotient of the braid action. Its representation theory furnishes a knot eigenbasis. This eigenbasis consists of states in \mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(A) indexed by knot equivalence classes that diagonalise the Hecke action. We compute this explicitly on the two-strand B_3 kernel. The knot eigenbasis serves as the structural pivot for subsequent substrate-arithmetic computations of binding energies and mass predictions.
